theme: From human motive to market movement: how desire becomes story, position, product strategy, distribution, and decisive writing.

days.chapter_or_section: Chapter 3, "Commitment and Consistency: Hobgoblins of the Mind"
days.fundamental: Persuasion: see how small public commitments reshape later behavior, and distinguish durable self-persuasion from coerced compliance theatre.
days.fallback_acquire_note: Available locally and in Drive. This advances beyond the already studied Chapter 1, "Weapons of Influence," and Chapter 2, "Reciprocation."

days.work: Story: Substance, Structure, Style, and the Principles of Screenwriting
days.fundamental: Storytelling: build scenes around changing value, turning behavior, and subtext so each unit forces the next instead of merely explaining it.
days.fallback_acquire_note: Available locally and in Drive. This follows the already studied McKee readings "The Substance of Story," "The Inciting Incident," and "Act Design." Canon prep must keep the scanned-PDF reading bounded to the verified Chapter 10 range.

days.work: Positioning: The Battle for Your Mind
days.fundamental: Positioning/brand: understand that market messages compete inside an already overloaded mind, so winning often means subtraction, contrast, and mental fit rather than more claims.
days.fallback_acquire_note: Available locally and in Drive. This is the direct follow-on to the already studied Chapter 1, "What Positioning Is All About."

days.fundamental: Human desire/psychology: treat apparently irrational behavior as adaptive signal, then ask what emotional, social, or contextual job the choice is really doing.
days.fallback_acquire_note: Available locally and in Drive. This remains unused in canon history and extends the earlier Alchemy readings "Introducing Psycho-Logic" and "Some Things Are Dishwasher-Proof, Others Are Reason-Proof."

days.chapter_or_section: Chapter 2, "Value Networks and the Impetus to Innovate"
days.fundamental: Tech/strategy: map how a firm's customers, margins, and performance metrics channel innovation effort toward one market logic while making adjacent demand look unattractive.
days.fallback_acquire_note: Available locally and in Drive. This moves into Chapter 2 after the two already studied Chapter 1 sections, and canon prep must verify the scanned-PDF boundary before assigning pages.

days.chapter_or_section: Chapter Two, section "What's the Aha Moment?"
days.fundamental: Distribution/growth: identify the user experience that makes the product click, then design onboarding and growth loops to accelerate arrival at that moment rather than inflate top-of-funnel noise.
days.fallback_acquire_note: Available locally and in Drive. The local EPUB confirms this named section follows the already studied "The Flameout of BranchOut" inside Chapter Two.

days.chapter_or_section: Chapter 2, "The Most Important Part of an Advertisement"
days.fundamental: Writing/taste: make the opening promise carry the burden of attention by foregrounding the prospect's self-interest before style, atmosphere, or cleverness.
days.fallback_acquire_note: Available locally and in Drive. This follows the already studied Caples Chapter 1, "The New Advertising Strategy," and uses the source edition's verified chapter title.
